# CYBOU — project status and source guide

CYBOU (https://cybou.fr/) is an open C++20 R&D project designed in France for sovereign communication infrastructure. The source repository is https://github.com/cybou-fr/cybou. The site describes both implemented DEV code and future architecture; it is not a production-service announcement.

## Implemented and tested in the repository

- Protocol-native AccountCreate with anti-Sybil work and an atomic OnboardingPool-to-SystemBalance grant.
- CYBOU state transitions, LevelDB persistence, finalized-block verification, block-height lookup, and a single-validator DEV block producer (f=0).
- A standalone experimental DEV node with remote operation submission and verified block synchronization between processes. The inherited Bitcoin bootstrap chain is a separate, transitional path.
- Core MailTx operation validation, deterministic size-aware fees, compact Mail discovery filters, and evidence bundle code with inclusion and finality proofs.
- An experimental Qt desktop client with Identity, Wallet, Email, Storage, and Backup pages. Service actions are gated by live capabilities; the complete Email and storage services are not available.
- Hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 operator-authority signature verification in core. This does not establish production post-quantum Email security.

## Design targets and remaining work

- Operate independent multi-validator BFT nodes. A minimum of four equal-weight validators is required before claiming f=1 tolerance.
- Integrate encrypted MailTx delivery, local Inbox/Sent/read-state indexes, and the target hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519 profile; perform external security review.
- Build decentralized Object Storage, Backup, and Drive services and complete operator key custody and public deployment work.
- DEV, Beta, and Mainnet have separate genesis and economics. Beta balances do not carry to Mainnet. The specified MAX_SUPPLY is 100,000,000,000 CYBOU with zero decimals and fees split 3:1 between Security and Onboarding; the inherited bootstrap chain does not implement this monetary policy.

- https://github.com/cybou-fr/cybou/blob/main/src/cybou/node_runtime.cpp — runtime shared with desktop.
- https://github.com/cybou-fr/cybou/blob/main/src/cybou/evidence.cpp — Mail evidence implementation.
